entities.summary: Carey Scurry is an American former professional basketball player. A 6 ft 7 in (2.01 m) small forward from Long Island University, Scurry played three seasons in the National Basketball Association (NBA) as a member of the Utah Jazz and New York Knicks. He averaged 4.7 points and 2.9 rebounds per game over the course of his NBA career. Scurry also played in Greece, Spain, and Brazil.
